description: An object constructor in parentheses is not a static map
notes: The spec makes object construction syntax a static map without saying whether parentheses around it, which only group in evaluation, keep it one. hashicorp/hcl keeps the parentheses as a ParenthesesExpr (hclsyntax/expression.go), which has no ExprMap method and can't be unwrapped, so hcl.ExprMap reports an error.
reference_error: A static map expression is required
